name: Shrinkerr
author: Shrinkerr
about: Converts finished downloads with Shrinkerr before Sonarr / Radarr import them.
description: After NZBGet completes a download, this extension sends its video files to Shrinkerr,
which queues them as Add to Queue would (your rules, languages and conversion filters).
Which downloads it processes — categories, Sonarr / Radarr tags — and whether it waits
for the conversion are set in Shrinkerr: Settings → Integrations → NZBGet / SABnzbd.
Requires: Shrinkerr running and reachable from NZBGet, and its API key.

commands.name: ConnectionTest
description: Tests connection to Shrinkerr and Sonarr
